Oliver (AE): New POC with AtlasFin. Compliance asked for EU-only processing, subprocessor inventory, and an explicit example of pinned-region routing + what happens on capacity shortage. Can we scope a small deliverable?
Maya (SE): Short answer: yes. We can provide a POC packet with subproc CSV, routing snippet, runbook, and a short note about control-plane telemetry. Need their expected QPS/tokens to estimate cost uplift.
Oliver (AE): Theyxpect ~18 r/s steady and up to 45 r/s during batch runs. Avg payload ~130 tokens. No BYOK for the POC.
Sam (SRE): Tech note: data plane (inference) can be constrained to EU regions we pick (eu-west1, eu-central1, eu-north1). For strict EU-only we set fallback: none which will make requests fail with 429/503 when capacity is unavailable. That needs a per-tenant routing rule and an ops ticket. Cost uplift estimate for their profile: ~11-16%.
Maya (SE): Example config we can hand to auditors: 
```
routing_policy:
  mode: geo_pin
  regions: [eu-west1, eu-central1]
  fallback: none     # fail-closed: return 429/503 if pinned regions exhausted
  cache_scope: regional
  telemetry: minimal
```
Maya (SE): Also include a curl example for their perf tests: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://eu-west1.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>" -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Priya (Legal): For the subprocessor list, we'll include cloud infra providers, CDN/edge vendors, logging and monitoring partners. Important legal point: call out that control-plane operational metadata (routing health, anonymized metrics, request hashes) may be processed in our control plane (us-central); no customer payloads or PII will be routed outside EU for the POC. I'll draft the paragraph for SOW.
Oliver (AE): Customer also asked if audit logs and request artefacts can be stored in EU-only buckets.
Sam (SRE): Yes 
we can configure audit/log retention in EU-only storage for the POC and offer a "no payload retention" flag. We'll document retention window (default 90 days) and how to opt out.
Maya (SE): Operational note to include: if they choose fail-closed, recommend client-side retry/backoff (3 retries, exp backoff). For load testing, we'll provide a small harness and perf expectations.
support-bot: PRESALES-15021 created. Owner: Sam (SRE). SLA: 48h.
Priya (Legal): Two asks for the packet: (1) confirm BYOK not requested for POC, (2) confirm customer accepts fail-closed behaviour and that will be recorded in the riser SOW.
Oliver (AE): Confirmed: no BYOK for POC, customer prefers fail-closed. I'll get sign-off and return.
Sam (SRE): I'll create the routing ticket and a one-page network path diagram + cost uplift calc. ETA 36h.
Maya (SE): I'll produce the runbook, YAML snippet, and example test harness by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (Legal): I'll upload subproc CSV and the SOW paragraph.
Oliver (AE): Thanks all
